title: Fix Puzzle 3D Play Dev End to End
description: puzzle 3d play dev server fails with Babel duplicate declaration BoardStructuralDeleteReporter in framework playground react renderer.
summary: Fixed the deterministic LLVM 22 wasm-component-ld SIGSEGV that blocked Puzzle 3D startup by overriding the release codegen-unit count only for the vcs cdylib while retaining the workspace-wide fast release profile. Verified cargo metadata, a complete puzzle-plugin wasm32-wasip2 release build, the canonical bun run dev:puzzle:3d startup through Vite on port 6013, HTTP 200, and browser runtime with the Concrete Forest example rendered in a 1265x626 canvas and zero browser warnings/errors.
